title: A Soul Without Purpose
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-02-07

Opens [Col 1](/bible/colossians/1) · [Jer 26](/bible/jeremiah/26) · [Isa 1](/bible/isaiah/1) · [Sir 11](/bible/sirach/11) · [Jer 17](/bible/jeremiah/17) · [Prov 24](/bible/proverbs/24) · [Prov 15](/bible/proverbs/15) · [Jer 1](/bible/jeremiah/1) · [1 Pet 5](/bible/1-peter/5) · [Rev 2](/bible/revelation/2) · [Mark 9](/bible/mark/9) · [John 5](/bible/john/5) · [Matt 9](/bible/matthew/9) · [Matt 8](/bible/matthew/8) · [Lev 17](/bible/leviticus/17) · [Eph 2](/bible/ephesians/2) · and 2 more below
## Introduction *[[6:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=379s)]* A deacon, with Captain Amaziah beside him, presses one question on the congregation: why did the Lord choose you out of thousands, and what are you doing with it? A soul without purpose will be destroyed in the fire that is coming, so the class walks from Paul's warning of every man, through Isaiah's call to reason together, Jeremiah's commission from the womb, the devil's prison in Revelation 2, and the deaf and dumb spirit of Mark 9, to the blood of Christ as the platform we build on. Along the way it deals plainly with brothers who want to give their rank up, sisters who blame leadership for not having a lord, and the demons that only fasting and prayer remove. ## In The News - *[[9:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=599s)]* **Bishop explains that the camp puts in so much work because the Lord has everybody numbered: the 144,000 are the leading men, and women, other men and children come in behind them, so there is no time to argue with foolishness while some brothers have never left their block.** — That is why you have to know what your purpose is. Ask yourself whether you are a man with no purpose, sitting through feast days doing nothing, burdened by who hit you or which officer you dislike, instead of focused on the mission. - *[[34:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=2047s)]* **A short imagines choosing your character before birth: ask for courage and the Creator gives you monsters, ask for patience and he makes you wait, ask for wisdom and he lets you fail, because a good life is the fire that forges you, and how you talk to yourself in the fire decides how you emerge.** — The fire is not to burn you but to purify you and pull things out of you. Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches all come from the Lord together, so stop wanting a balanced life; the work is your profession. - *[[48:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=2885s)]* **A short on lessons life teaches: nothing lasts forever, so stay humble at your highest and keep faith at your lowest; every failure is a stepping stone; and kindness costs nothing.** — The whole world is set up to challenge us, and you are supposed to challenge it back rather than walk away. Satan tells you that you will be good out in the world, but that good is only for a moment before the full attack comes. - *[[1:23:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=5033s)]* **A montage of our people in clubs, parties and churches, and in Islam.** — That is us destroying ourselves, the same demon that cast the boy into the fire and the water. The club that gets sprayed, the drunk drive that costs your legs, the religion that keeps you bound: we called it fun, and it was a dumb spirit. - *[[2:07:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=7645s)]* **A short: the God who flung the stars into the sky is in control of your life, so stop worrying, trust him, and let him lead you to peace and purpose.** — Most of our problems come from not letting God lead. Hebrews 13:17 says the leaders watch over your soul, but the camp is here to teach the law, not to match-make; if you want a lord or a wife, go to the Lord for it. - *[[2:10:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=7838s)]* **A short: you trust the bus without knowing the driver and the plane without knowing the pilot, so why not trust life knowing God is steering it; do your part and leave the rest in his hands.** — People board planes with strangers at the controls but will not trust the leaders God set over them. Desperate sisters would rather take a back-door marriage that is hell on earth than wait for the Lord, and one in a thousand of those works. ## Scriptures Opened **[Colossians 1:28](/bible/colossians/1#v28)** *[[6:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=379s)]* > [28](/bible/colossians/1#v28) Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus: - Whom we preach, warning every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus. Every class is a warning, because destruction is coming; that is the business the camp is in, in the classroom, on the radio, on TV and in the street. - Ask yourself every morning why the Lord chose you out of thousands. He knows where you were and where you are now, and he could have removed you. A soul with no purpose is going to be destroyed. - Brothers who want to give their rank up do not understand the work. The life you used to live died with Christ; now you live his life and do his work. A brother asked how to balance his life: this truth is the balance, and there is no life after it. Precepts: - **[Malachi 4:1](/bible/malachi/4#v1)** > [1](/bible/malachi/4#v1) For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch. The day cometh that shall burn as an oven, and all the proud and all that do wickedly shall be stubble. Last time it was water; this time the fire burns the soul and you feel it while you are in it. Pride and wickedness are the fuel, so let whatever you are into go before the fire comes. Sabbath sickness is a slogan for lazy bums. **[Jeremiah 26:3-5](/bible/jeremiah/26#v3)** *[[16:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=983s)]* > [3](/bible/jeremiah/26#v3) If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings. > > [4](/bible/jeremiah/26#v4) And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you, > > [5](/bible/jeremiah/26#v5) To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened; - If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings. God wants you to take heed and turn. - Go deep within yourself the way you research something online. If you have problems with brothers, something is wrong with you; the greatest commandment is to love God and your neighbour as yourself, and there is no time for hatred when we are at war together. Pull up the seed that is choking you before it grows into a root of bitterness that keeps you on the couch instead of in class. - The Lord sends his prophets every morning, rising up early, and the people do not hearken; then when the fire comes they blame God. Look at the platform being built, brothers travelling to other countries, and ask whether you are doing enough instead of sitting on the couch pumped up on evil. **[Isaiah 1:16-24](/bible/isaiah/1#v16)** *[[20:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=1254s)]* > [16](/bible/isaiah/1#v16) Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil; > > [17](/bible/isaiah/1#v17) Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow. > > [18](/bible/isaiah/1#v18) Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool. > > [19](/bible/isaiah/1#v19) If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land: > > [20](/bible/isaiah/1#v20) But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it. > > [21](/bible/isaiah/1#v21) How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers. > > [22](/bible/isaiah/1#v22) Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water: > > [23](/bible/isaiah/1#v23) Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them. > > [24](/bible/isaiah/1#v24) Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies: - Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow. When evil thoughts come, fight them and keep examining whether you believe this is a family. - Come now, and let us reason together. God shows you your condition, a sinful nation, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters, and says though your sins be as scarlet they shall be white as snow. If ye be willing and obedient ye shall eat the good of the land; if ye refuse and rebel ye shall be devoured with the sword. The Black community has been devoured with the sword of God because it will not return. - How we know there is a God: look at our condition, which Islam, Christianity and voodoo could not change. Look at Haiti where voodoo rules. Only the true God can change it, so humble yourself. - Thy princes are rebellious and companions of thieves; every one loveth gifts and followeth after rewards. America feeds the so-called leaders welfare and Section 8, raises up the ones who could be a threat, and they sell their own mother for the dollar. That is what we become without God's law, and the law is still active: reject marriage and you get a community of baby mothers. Because you become God's enemy by disobeying, he will ease himself of his adversaries. **[Sirach 11:14](/bible/sirach/11#v14)** *[[35:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=2152s)]* > [14](/bible/sirach/11#v14) Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord. - Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord. You will always find them together; in prosperity you never know a friend, in adversity you learn he never was one. So do not fear these things when they happen, and stop asking the Lord for blessings and jobs while doing nothing to earn them. **[Jeremiah 17:7-8](/bible/jeremiah/17#v7)** *[[37:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=2249s)]* > [7](/bible/jeremiah/17#v7) Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is. > > [8](/bible/jeremiah/17#v8) For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit. - Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is. Whatever condition you are in, poverty, riches, life or death, put your trust in him, because it all comes from him, as with Job when Satan came before God. What fights against that trust is your own thoughts, so say: I may not understand this, but the Lord is teaching me something. - The demon that let you leave the world does not want to be controlled, which is why brothers and sisters who bounce end up back in pants in the grocery store; Satan takes full control. There is nowhere to hide from this truth, so humble yourself and learn to do well. The most powerful brother is the one who can discipline himself. - He shall be as a tree planted by the waters, that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when the heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green. Next to the water you never lack, and the sun does not burn you. Some brothers do not come to the war room for weeks because they do not want that water. Precepts: - **[Proverbs 31:26](/bible/proverbs/31#v26)** > [26](/bible/proverbs/31#v26) She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness. She openeth her mouth with wisdom, and in her tongue is the law of kindness. That is a sister who stays green. If that verse is not fulfilled in your house, that is why the house is not blessed. And 'can I explain myself' after admitting every charge is of the devil; correction cuts both ways, healing the one corrected and the one correcting. **[Proverbs 24:10](/bible/proverbs/24#v10)** *[[47:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=2830s)]* > [10](/bible/proverbs/24#v10) If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small. - If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small. This whole life is hard times; the day after the feast you might get fired. When it happens you do not run, you stay still and fight. Going through things is how you test your strength: did you stand when the correction came? - Where can you go to hide from correction when you know where you came from? The world is set up to challenge you, and you challenge it back and make yourself great. Do not lie down because Satan knocked you down; get up and walk. **[Proverbs 15:14](/bible/proverbs/15#v14)** *[[52:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=3168s)]* > [14](/bible/proverbs/15#v14) The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness. - The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge, but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness. Young men in the war room want that water, while brothers of fifty years in the same congregation never show up. Seek wisdom from leadership yourself; do not wait to be told to come to the desk. One brother from the Memphis camp asked to sit in the hot seat and be rebuked. - A brother said he did not know the fifty was going to be this hard; he was looking for a 401k and a pension. There is no retirement plan in this truth. Much is given, so much is required. When the Connecticut brothers drove two hours to Brooklyn for the Sabbath, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and the high holy days, sometimes with a homeless man in the car, nobody complained, because we were looking for the work. - A fool looks for who he can talk sports or his job with; a man seeking knowledge seeks the war room. Some brothers think they already have the wisdom and do not need leadership, and then correction comes and they move like a woman, all emotion. Precepts: - **[Jeremiah 3:15](/bible/jeremiah/3#v15)** > [15](/bible/jeremiah/3#v15) And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding. I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding. Your pastors could have been the covetous men of the world; the Lord led you to pastors who help you build. So why stay away from them, or go on the quest to have fun rather than to learn? **[Jeremiah 1:4-10](/bible/jeremiah/1#v4)** *[[1:02:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=3750s)]* > [4](/bible/jeremiah/1#v4) Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, > > [5](/bible/jeremiah/1#v5) Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. > > [6](/bible/jeremiah/1#v6) Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child. > > [7](/bible/jeremiah/1#v7) But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak. > > [8](/bible/jeremiah/1#v8) Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord. > > [9](/bible/jeremiah/1#v9) Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth. > > [10](/bible/jeremiah/1#v10) See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant. - Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, and before thou camest forth I sanctified thee, and ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. Whatever weakness is in you is no coincidence, and neither is the seat you sit in. Ask yourself why you are here and not dead in the world. - Jeremiah said, I cannot speak, for I am a child, as Moses did. The Lord said, Say not I am a child, for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak. That is a commandment; Jeremiah had no choice, and neither do we. We were ordained from birth, so do not let Satan take the prize. We speak what we are commanded: Christ is a Black man sent to the twelve tribes. - Be not afraid of their faces, for I am with thee to deliver thee. Whatever you go through is of him and he will deliver you out of it; do not skip the Sabbath because you lost your job, everybody is going through things and we comfort one another. 'I used to be an Israelite' is the dumbest thing ever heard. - I have put my words in thy mouth; I have set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, pull down, destroy and throw down, to build and to plant. Shake off the low self-esteem: the Black man has the strength to build brothers and sisters and to prophesy the destruction of these nations. Precepts: - **[Haggai 1:4](/bible/haggai/1#v4)** > [4](/bible/haggai/1#v4) Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste? Is it time for you to dwell in your ceiled houses, and the house of the Lord lie waste? Now is not the time to build your own house first. **[1 Peter 5:8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8)** *[[1:09:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=4189s)]* > [8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8) Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour: - Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about seeking whom he may devour. Once you acknowledge who you are, he comes for you. He is not looking for the bum who does nothing; he already has him where he wants him. He looks for the leaders and the young men doing the work. - If Satan cannot get to you he gets to your wife, your children, your dog, your chickens and your goats, anything to get your attention. Sober means paying attention so you see his work coming, especially when you travel; the attack starts at the airport. But there is a reward, so we do not complain about balance; the little job is temporary and this is the profession. **[Revelation 2:10](/bible/revelation/2#v10)** *[[1:12:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=4368s)]* > [10](/bible/revelation/2#v10) Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life. - Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried, and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Christ told the apostles life would not be easy; Peter talked tough and Christ told him to be quiet. Brothers who say they would die for a leader punk out at the first correction. - Some of us are going to prison for the love of our people. Ask yourself whether you are ready; some cannot do a month or even a day. If you find yourself where you cannot teach, it is because the Lord wants to purify something in you: fast, pray, and he will take you out. - Be thou faithful unto death. Whatever state you find yourself in, jail, torture, losing an eye or an arm, be faithful, because pain is part of the walk. The body is not you; your soul is you, so prepare your soul for the pain that is coming with Esau's children. - Get rid of your own personal demonic sin before you line a brother up for his failure. In the furnace every evil thought and secret act against the congregation comes back. Precepts: - **[Romans 15:4](/bible/romans/15#v4)** > [4](/bible/romans/15#v4) For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. Whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope. When jail, affliction and tribulation come, you remember you read it, so you humble yourself to see what the Lord is showing you. - **[Psalms 140:4](/bible/psalms/140#v4)** > [4](/bible/psalms/140#v4) Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings. Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man, who have purposed to overthrow my goings. The spiritual Satan and the physical Satan work as a team, in your head asleep or awake and jumping into people at your job. **[Mark 9:21-29](/bible/mark/9#v21)** *[[1:21:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=4877s)]* > [21](/bible/mark/9#v21) And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child. > > [22](/bible/mark/9#v22) And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us. > > [23](/bible/mark/9#v23) Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth. > > [24](/bible/mark/9#v24) And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. > > [25](/bible/mark/9#v25) When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him. > > [26](/bible/mark/9#v26) And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead. > > [27](/bible/mark/9#v27) But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose. > > [28](/bible/mark/9#v28) And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out? > > [29](/bible/mark/9#v29) And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting. - The spirit ofttimes cast the child into the fire and into the waters to destroy him. That is what religion and the world were given to us for: to destroy us. The paycheck spent in the club that gets sprayed up, the drunk drive that costs you your limbs, the mob on Eastern Parkway; the demon in us told us that was cool. - If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth. Your belief is your power. The father cried, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. When Satan keeps attacking you, your faith is weak; go fast and ask the Lord to strengthen it. - Christ charged the dumb and deaf spirit to come out and enter no more. Dumb is spending your money in the club and leaving your house to run with no-good negroes; deaf is not listening and not seeing your condition. When it left, the boy looked dead, then Christ lifted him up and he arose, and now we wake up and see it was a dumb spirit. - The same dumb spirit tells a single sister that since leadership has not given her a lord she should go get one in the world and bring him in, when she caught nothing in the world before. Some sisters are here for the ride, not the work, and do not do the work on the body; know your size before you point at the fit brother. Some of you are not going to get a lord in this captivity, and if that is what you came for, Satan will move you out of the way. - This kind can come forth by nothing but by prayer and fasting. Some demons are higher than others, and that is why you have to fast and pray and not let it conquer you. God put leadership in your life to watch over your soul; instead of pointing at them, fix yourself, be the Proverbs 31 woman, stop eating the ice cream at night, and earn it rather than assume you deserve it. Precepts: - **[Genesis 30:2](/bible/genesis/30#v2)** > [2](/bible/genesis/30#v2) And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb? Rachel demanded children and Jacob asked, Am I in God's stead? The same answer to sisters demanding a lord from leadership: go ask God for it, and ask what he wants you to change first. **[John 5:14-15](/bible/john/5#v14)** *[[1:39:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=5983s)]* > [14](/bible/john/5#v14) Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee. > > [15](/bible/john/5#v15) The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole. - Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee. A Christian said once Christ casts the demon out they never sin again; Christ himself said otherwise. The sister who left stripping two years ago and wants to go back for the money is not going back to the same world; every year sin multiplies and different demons jump on people. **[Matthew 9:22-34](/bible/matthew/9#v22)** *[[1:41:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k68LEa5wIdY&t=6082s)]* > [22](/bible/matthew/9#v22) But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour. > > [23](/bible/matthew/9#v23) And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise, > > [24](/bible/matthew/9#v24) He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn. > > [25](/bible/matthew/9#v25) But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose. > > [26](/bible/matthew/9#v26) And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land. > > [27](/bible/matthew/9#v27) And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us. > > [28](/bible/matthew/9#v28) And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord. > > [29](/bible/matthew/9#v29) Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you. > > [30](/bible/matthew/9#v30) And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it. > > [31](/bible/matthew/9#v31) But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country. > > [32](/bible/matthew/9#v32) As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil. > > [33](/bible/matthew/9#v33) And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel. > > [34](/bible/matthew/9#v34) But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils. - Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. The man in Mark had to ask for his faith to be strengthened, but her faith was strong and healed her from that hour. - When the devil was cast out, the dumb spake, and the multitudes said it was never so seen in Israel. But the Pharisees said he casteth out devils through the prince of the devils. That is the other Israelite camps speaking evil of the work: they say we are of Satan while we are out here casting demons.
